1: export const delayUnit = 1;
2: export function retryDelay(attempt: number, factor: number = 2, queue?: string): number {
3:   if (attempt < 0) throw new RangeError("attempt");
4:   const cap = queue === "urgent" ? 500 : 10000;
5:   const exponential = Math.min(cap, 50 * factor ** Math.floor(attempt));
6:   return exponential * delayUnit;
7: }
8: export const nextDelay = retryDelay;
9: 
10: export function retryBudget(attempt: number, factor: number = 2, queue?: string) {
11:   const wait = retryDelay(attempt, factor, queue);
12:   const remaining = Math.max(0, 6 - Math.floor(attempt));
13:   return { wait, remaining };
14: }
15: 
16: export function retryCost(attempt: number): number {
17:   return retryBudget(attempt, 2, "standard").wait / delayUnit;
18: }

20: export interface RetryItem {
21:   id: string;
22:   attempt: number;
23:   due: number;
24:   lastError?: string;
25: }
26: 
27: export class RetryWheel {
28:   private buckets = new Map<number, RetryItem[]>();
29:   private ids = new Set<string>();
30:   readonly resolution: number;
31:   constructor(resolution = 100) {
32:     this.resolution = resolution;
33:     if (resolution <= 0) throw new RangeError("resolution");
34:   }
35:   add(item: RetryItem) {
36:     if (this.ids.has(item.id)) return false;
37:     const tick = Math.ceil(item.due / this.resolution);
38:     const bucket = this.buckets.get(tick) ?? [];
39:     bucket.push({ ...item });
40:     this.buckets.set(tick, bucket);
41:     this.ids.add(item.id);
42:     return true;
43:   }
44:   advance(now: number) {
45:     const boundary = Math.floor(now / this.resolution);
46:     const ready: RetryItem[] = [];
47:     const ticks = [...this.buckets.keys()].filter((tick) => tick <= boundary).sort((a, b) => a - b);
48:     for (const tick of ticks) {
49:       for (const item of this.buckets.get(tick)!) {
50:         this.ids.delete(item.id);
51:         ready.push(item);
52:       }
53:       this.buckets.delete(tick);
54:     }
55:     return ready;
56:   }
57:   remove(id: string) {
58:     if (!this.ids.delete(id)) return false;
59:     for (const [tick, bucket] of this.buckets) {
60:       const remaining = bucket.filter((item) => item.id !== id);
61:       if (remaining.length) this.buckets.set(tick, remaining);
62:       else this.buckets.delete(tick);
63:     }
64:     return true;
65:   }
66:   get size() {
67:     return this.ids.size;
68:   }
69: }
